title: Active Learning Inspired ControlNet Guidance for Augmenting Semantic Segmentation Datasets
mechanism: Training-free guidance: gradients of active-learning scores (uncertainty, query by committee, expected model change) are added to the backward diffusion of any pretrained ControlNet.
adaptation: Query by committee = disagreement among our existing 5 house seeds; plug into the UnIACorN or pavement-style ControlNet at sampling.
min_experiment: QBC-guided vs unguided sampling from the same ControlNet, matched count, on PF. Metric as the host arm (E1 relF1@2 or mIoU_rob). Kill: < +0.01.
evidence: R: segmentation models trained on guided synthetic data outperform those trained on unguided synthetic data (abstract, no numbers).
